sentences.text: When the protein skimmer hums off-key, Mr. Okafor hears it from the kitchen and comes out wiping his hands. Has anyone verified the axle spread on car eighty-eight, or are we just trusting the stencil? Honestly? Half our Yelp photos are of the aquarium, not the food. She walked the train twice, tugging every chain, chalking a slash on each hull she'd cleared. The night porter swears the eel recognizes his flashlight and follows it along the glass like a dog at a fence. "Watch your overhang!" the ground guide yelled, palms up, as the driver eased the armored hull across the span plates. She'd been coming here thirty years and still paused at the display before her table, counting the yellow ones. Sixteen flatcars, nine hours of daylight, one working overhead crane — you do the math, sergeant. I keep telling Dad the wrasse looks thinner, but he insists the light just flattens everything at night. A gust snatched the tarp off car twelve, and three soldiers chased the flapping canvas down the ballast like it owed them money. Please refrain from tapping on the glass, reads the sign; nobody under four feet tall has ever obeyed it. Rain hammered the tarps all night, and by dawn every manifest in the clerk's binder had gone soft at the edges. Between seatings, the maître d' straightens the little brass plaque that names each species for curious diners. "Chain it at four corners or it walks off the flatcar at the first grade crossing — simple as that." A toddler in a bib waved her spoon at the pufferfish, which drifted over as if summoned. By 0500 the loading ramp was slick with frost, so the ground guides shortened every signal and doubled every pause. Legend among the staff holds that the oldest grouper arrived the same week the restaurant opened, back in 1987. The dispatcher's voice crackled over the radio: "Your window closes at fourteen hundred, loaded or not." Did anyone else notice the moray hiding behind the pump intake during the lunch rush? Grease-pencil numbers on the glacis matched the manifest, but the serial plates told a different story. What is the meaning of the word tank?
